title: G9 same-run source readback does not yet own the per-trial semantic payload transport
counterexample: In the target probe, each semantic trial process receives the raw semantic payload bytes, constructs the CellUptakeReceipt with downstream_sha256=sha256(payload), constructs/seals its runtime witness, and then calls ReentryDerivedSemanticState.observe with semantic_payload=payload. The separate current-subject independent source/readback discriminator runs afterward in distinct source/observer processes, but it does not carry or independently attest the exact per-trial semantic payload bytes consumed by those four semantic trials. Co-execution in one workflow therefore does not establish that the independent source authority mediated the semantic treatment.
scope_consequence: Run 33622364637 is real target execution and supports target-environment component runtime, the no-bypass semantic target-runtime candidate, and same-subject independent source-readback credit. It does not yet support semantic_gwt_runtime_credit=1. The raw controller receipt itself correctly records semantic_gwt_runtime_credit_candidate=1 and semantic_gwt_runtime_credit=0.
required_next_discriminator: Independently own/source and read back the exact per-trial semantic slot bytes through the GWT/reentry transport. The trial/behavioral process must not receive raw semantic payload, payload digest, arm/class/trial label, or caller-built uptake metadata; it may consume only independently recovered reentry semantic state. Include sham/bypass hard negatives and fresh process isolation.
